name: wps
description: Websites monorepo for White Point Survey

scripts.build: pnpm run build:main && pnpm run build:document && pnpm run build:api
scripts.deploy: pnpm run deploy:main && pnpm run deploy:document && pnpm run deploy:api
scripts.type-check: pnpm --filter cfdg/input exec tsc -b && pnpm --filter cfdg/layout exec tsc -b && pnpm --filter cfdg/scripts exec tsc -b && pnpm --filter cfdg/types exec tsc -b && pnpm --filter main exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter document exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter api exec tsc --noEmit
